name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Trajectory-based 1-2 frame press and wave release input buffer.

show-saves.name: Show Save Popup
show-saves.description: Shows a small popup each time the buffer delays an input to save you.

buffer-level.name: Buffer Level (0 = OFF, 1-20)
buffer-level.description: How far the buffer may delay an input. 1 = 2 ticks, 4 = 16/8 ticks, 20 = 144/72 ticks. High levels can lag or crash the game.

dont-skip-ship.name: Don't Skip Ship
dont-skip-ship.description: Also apply the buffer in ship mode (normally ship is skipped). Experimental.

sim-budget-ms.name: Sim Budget (ms)
sim-budget-ms.description: Max milliseconds one click may spend simulating ahead. Higher = buffer works more often but can lag. If you see 'out of time' popups, raise this. Lower it if the game stutters.
